fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description:
Detects applications trying to modify the registry in order to disable any write-protect property for storage devices.
This could be a precursor to a ransomware attack and has been an observed technique used by cypherpunk group.
fields.name: Write Protect For Storage Disabled
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "\\System\\CurrentControlSet\\Control" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "Write Protection" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "0" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "storage"))
